data.description:
## Incident Overview

The orchestrator (in a host project session) wasted 8+ tool turns trying to invoke \`.claude/scripts/dso ticket transition <id> closed --reason=\"Fixed: ...\"\` because the CLI's \`--help\` output and error messages do not adequately surface the correct syntax. Documentation should provide better in-line guidance and error messages should be more helpful in enabling the agent to correct their syntax without iterative trial.

## Reproducer

In a host project session with v1.13.0:

\`\`\`
\$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket transition --help
Usage: ticket transition <ticket_id> <current_status> <target_status>
       ticket transition <ticket_id> <target_status>  (auto-detects current status)
  current_status / target_status: open | in_progress | closed | blocked
\`\`\`

Then attempting to add a reason:

\`\`\`
\$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket transition 60ec-4605 closed --reason=\"Fixed: commit 8c4d2afc\"
Error: invalid target_status '--reason=Fixed: commit 8c4d2afc'. Must be one of: open, in_progress, closed, blocked

\$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket transition --reason \"Fixed: commit 8c4d2afc\" 60ec-4605 closed
Error: invalid current_status 'Fixed: commit 8c4d2afc'. Must be one of: open, in_progress, closed, blocked

\$ .claude/scripts/dso ticket transition 60ec-4605 closed \"Fixed: commit 8c4d2afc\"
Error: invalid target_status 'Fixed: commit 8c4d2afc on main — bundled fix'. Must be one of: open, in_progress, closed, blocked
\`\`\`

The agent has no path to discover that \`--reason=\` is a separate flag that follows the positional args, OR that the bug ticket close requires the reason at all (CLI did emit \"closing a bug ticket requires --reason\" in one branch but not in the auto-detect branch).

## Expected vs Observed

**Expected:** \`ticket transition --help\` shows \`--reason=\"<text>\"\` as a flag with an example for bug closures. Error messages on bug-close failure print the exact correct invocation, including positional arg order.

**Observed:** Help text omits flags entirely. Error message lists valid statuses but not flags. Auto-detect branch silently rejects bug closures without reason. Trial-and-error churn over 8+ turns.

## Bug Scope

(1) \`ticket transition --help\` should enumerate flags including \`--reason=\`, with an example bug-close invocation. (2) Error message when target_status='closed' on a bug should print: \`Hint: bug closures require --reason=\"Fixed: <summary>\". Example: ticket transition <id> closed --reason=\"Fixed: ...\"\`. (3) Audit other ticket subcommands (\`comment\`, \`link\`, \`tag\`) for similar in-line guidance gaps.

## Proposed Investigation

Audit \`plugins/dso/scripts/ticket\` (and the lib-api dispatcher) for: subcommand-level \`--help\` output that includes flags, error-path hints that suggest the next correct invocation rather than just \"invalid X\".
data.title: [ticket CLI]: orchestrator unable to discover correct subcommand syntax -> repeated invalid-flag churn
